entities.summary: "Dame Tu Cosita" is a song by Panamanian artist El Chombo, featuring Jamaican dancehall musician Cutty Ranks. It was originally recorded on March 31 1997, but extended and released as a single in April 2018. A remix with Pitbull and Karol G was released on August 29, 2018.
